hero.title: Professional PDR Estimation
hero.subtitle: PDR Kalk creates hail damage estimates and parking damage reports in seconds — with official insurance tariffs, CHF rounding, and print-ready documents.

features.title: Everything a PDR Professional Needs
features.subtitle: Built for PDR workshops — legally accurate, precise, efficient.

items.title: Hail Damage Estimation
items.desc: Create an estimate in under a minute with integrated insurance tariffs (VFFS 2025, Zurich 2024). All details on one screen — deviations are automatically flagged for the insurer. Professional and trustworthy.

items.title: Parking Damage Entry
items.desc: Lightning-fast entry — flat-rate price or per-panel pricing. Create a report in under a minute, attach photos and send your customer the PDF or invoice directly.

items.title: 5 Document Types
items.desc: Cost estimate, work report, receipt, invoice, and parking damage report — all print-ready as PDF. Customizable messages for private and business customers, with your own document prefixes and starting numbers.

items.title: Status Management & Workflow
items.desc: Keep track of every job at a glance. Reports: Accepted, Completed, Cancelled. Invoices: Created, Sent, Paid, Overdue. Professional workflow management built right in.

items.title: Photo Documentation
items.desc: Easily add photos to any report — choose your own compression level for optimal file size. 2 photos per page with optional descriptions, embedded directly into your PDF documents.

items.title: Local & Structured
items.desc: Installable on PC or tablet. All documents, photos and backups are saved locally in a structured folder system. Complete data backup with one click.
